about: The harbor's views (VS-10, owner: the harbor cell; Design/POIs/sombre.harbor.md). VS-15 adds hale_arrival, VS-19 the night_quay_* views. The core's quay_storm/quay_calm/quay_night stay the core's. Views only: the core file owns the route and art_sentinels.

viewpoints.expectation: Just after the strike, from the west end of the quay: the Ida at her berth with Varga aboard, Mara waiting on the quay, and the dark tower above the town to the north-east.
Over the harbor water: the tower to the north-east and the false-light post to the west in one frame; the Grey a small far silhouette or not at all.
The harbor mouth: clear rocks where Remy's boat will be, not a boat (held for VS-20).
